data.name: Slack: Send Message
data.description: Send a message to a Slack channel or user. Provide the channel/conversation ID and message text.
data.instructions:
Send a message to a Slack channel.

Post a text message to a specific Slack channel. The bot must be a member of the channel.

**Inputs:**
- {channel}: The Slack channel ID (bot must be a member)
- {message}: Message text (supports Slack markdown formatting)

**Output:** {result} contains the sent message confirmation including timestamp.
